description: Baza danych geodezyjnej ewidencji sieci uzbrojenia terenu (GESUT), powiat giżycki 2806 is a dataset listed in Geo-System metadata catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by bip.spgizycko.warmia.mazury.pl. The geodetic database of land weapon networks collects data on the spatial distribution of above-ground, above-ground and underground objects of the land weapon networks and information on the entities in possession of these networks. Coverage: PL. The portal shows the English title as "Geodetic Land Weapons Network Database (GESUT), Giżycko County 2806" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-podgik.
